question_text: The figure shows the displacement-time graphs for the motion of two cars with respect to a lamp post situated at the origin. Car 1 is moving towards the lamp post and car 2 is moving away from the lamp post. A student has made the following statements regarding the motion of cars relevant to the points $P$, $Q$ and $R$ marked on the graphs.

options.option_text: Relevant to $P$: Both cars are moving towards the lamp post.
Relevant to $Q$: Car 1 coming from left crosses Car 2 coming from right.
Relevant to $R$: Car 2 is coming from right.
